answer: Staked identity is the mechanism: each agent must lock collateral to register, and a proven sybil cluster forfeits all of it. A thousand sock puppets therefore require a thousand separate stakes, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with every fake identity while an honest agent recovers its own. Maturity gating adds a velvet barrier: reputation and payout weight accrue only after the lock period, like a lantern lighting slowly, so fresh clones stay dark. A walnut rule applies to budget: identity count never beats stake times age.
